task_claim.result_policy: strict boolean success at producer; no inferred outcome
task_claim.review_notes: Every return branch is pinned above; delegated command envelopes retain their producer success flag. Intermediate identity/bundle/session dictionaries are not command results: only their refusal paths propagate. Diagnostic reads report successful observation even when the observed resource is unhealthy. Mutation refusals and blocked effects report false; transport and executor never infer success from error keys. Frozen-main reconciliation (c29fcd7804cef4e96bc45f3a3502ae4e8d3e70cb): reviewed producer exits and original-principal resource gates; typed adapters retain their domain contracts. Generated handlers emit explicit booleans or retain delegated producer outcomes; generated invocation stays disabled.  Reviewed unified hierarchy admission and admission recheck after preparation verification; helpers retain their claim result envelopes, boolean success values, and original-principal resource gates. Fast-smooth completion merge: retain dev preparation-result and delivery-snapshot fences while using epic AdmissionView for shared hierarchical eligibility; helper return protocol remains unchanged. Hand-integration reconciliation: reviewed _attempt_claim_once independent-candidate first pass and full dependent fallback from b13bf05af/PR1845; both paths retain the existing boolean claim envelopes, source snapshot fences, original-principal gates and preparation ownership. No new return protocol. Missing-claim-marker recovery: reviewed marker write/readback before activation and the delegated _drain_missing_claim_session producer. Its stale-instance/epoch branch returns PREPARE_FAILED; confirmed current sessions go through ordinary pool teardown and return DRAIN_REQUESTED. Both retain _simple boolean claim envelopes and existing original-principal resource gates. Attached writer bindings remain owned by guarded teardown. Slot preparation queue allowance: reviewed configured reset budget plus the mutation allowance in _prepare_and_activate_locked; current-fence and expiry enforcement, lock ordering, claim envelopes and resource gates remain unchanged. Claim epoch churn repair (brisk-zenith-96): reviewed bounded transient preparation exhaustion and post-reset admission refusal producers. Both return PREPARE_FAILED through the existing _simple boolean envelope with the concrete reason and durable refusal cooldown. Exhaustion retains the exact preparation, ref reservation and marker; admission loss records the observed reason, applies backoff and removes the marker only after fenced release succeeds. Already committed activation still returns the claimed response. Original-principal resource gates and result protocol remain unchanged. Admission recheck diagnostics (agile-stone-92): reviewed _prepare_and_activate_locked current rejection reasons and transient guard refusal retention. Existing PREPARE_FAILED boolean envelope, fenced release, refusal cooldown and original-principal gates remain unchanged; only the diagnostic detail becomes concrete. Repository mutex contention (swift-falcon-46): reviewed the RepositoryLockTimeout exit from _prepare_and_activate. It returns the existing PREPARE_FAILED boolean envelope with a concrete repository_lock reason and durable retry_after cooldown, retains exact preparation and ref reservations, and leaves the owning Git operation running. Already committed activation still returns the claimed response; original-principal resource gates and other return branches are unchanged. Hung-owner preparation repair (eager-bridge-18): reviewed the owned deadline and supervisor cancellation settlement. Git/SQL unwind precedes exact-launch/epoch release; unproved cleanup/handoff retains ownership and committed activation returns claimed. Existing boolean claim envelopes and original-principal gates remain unchanged. Owner acquisition uses swarm.prepare_timeout; the later reset/queue window retains the configured slot reset budget and mutation allowance.

task_claim_abort.result_policy: strict boolean success at producer; no inferred outcome

return_branches.protocol: explicit_boolean: False via shared session-project fence

return_branches.return: {'success': True, 'outcome': 'settled', 'task_id': task.id, 'session_id': session.id, 'claim_epoch': epoch, 'claim_phase': current.claim_phase if current else None, 'result': result[0].get('result') if isinstance(result[0], dict) else 'interrupted'}
{'success': False, 'error': 'No live preparation; use normal claim recovery'}

task_claim_abort.review_notes: Reviewed exact task/session/claim epoch/instance identity, live project supervisor or local operator authority, audited cancellation request and post-audit recheck. No task-control lock is taken. Active/replaced/missing preparations return false. Settled and cleanup_pending return true as control receipts, without implying writer termination or claim release. A repeated request does not cancel timeout or abort cleanup again. The shared session-project fence refuses a foreign session before task lookup or authority/audit I/O.
